pages.text: The pack sets these defaults so nothing clashes. Change any of them in Settings → Controls.$(br2)$(#b9a98a)Key - Does$()$(br)$(bold)E$() - Inventory (with the skills panel)$(br)$(bold)M$() - World map$(br)$(bold)H$() - Missions$(br)$(bold)B$() - Backpack$(br)$(bold);$() - Team$(br)$(bold)U$() - Waypoints$(br)$(bold)J$() - New waypoint$(br)$(bold)V$() - Voice chat settings$(br)$(bold)O$() - Mute microphone$(br)$(bold)Left Alt$() - Create's toolbelt$(br)$(bold)Z$() - Zoom$(br2)The ESC menu's buttons press these keys for you, so the menu works even if you rebind them.
